verses.text: Paul here—Jesus’ servant, called to be an apostle, drafted for God’s gospel campaign.
This gospel? God soft-launched it through His prophets in the OG scrolls.
It’s centered on His Son—descended from David, born in the flesh, no cap.
But declared Son of God with power when He clapped death—resurrection certified by the Holy Spirit.
Through Him, I got the assignment: call all nations to trust and obey for His name’s rep.
That includes y’all in Rome—on God’s contact list, tagged and chosen.
To everyone in Rome, loved by God, called to be saints: grace and peace from the Father and the Lord Jesus.
First off—big thanks to God for y’all. Your faith is literally trending worldwide.
God knows I’m not ghosting—He sees me praying for you 24/7.
I’m always asking: “God, can I finally pull up to Rome?”
I wanna link up and drop some spiritual upgrades—get y’all powered up.
Actually, I wanna get boosted too—your faith and mine, mutual XP.
I’ve been trying to visit, but life kept lagging. I want fruit in Rome like I’ve seen elsewhere.
I owe the message to everyone—Greeks, non-Greeks, brainiacs, and normies.
So yeah, I’m hyped to preach in Rome too.
I’m not ashamed of the gospel—it’s God’s cheat code for saving anyone who believes: Jews first, then everybody else.
It reveals God’s righteousness, start to finish, faith to faith. “The righteous live by faith”—that’s the verse.
But God’s wrath? It’s live-streaming from heaven—aimed at all who suppress truth with wickedness.
What’s real about God? Already in plain sight—He made it obvious.
Since creation, His invisible traits—power and divinity—have been on full display. No excuses.
They knew God but refused to honor or thank Him. Their minds glitched, hearts went grayscale.
They called themselves wise but turned into walking L’s.
They swapped God’s glory for bootleg idols—humans, birds, beasts, and literal bugs.
So God said, “Bet”—and let them spiral into dirty desires, bodies downgraded.
They traded truth for cap, worshiped creation instead of the Creator—who stays praised forever. Amen.
That’s why God let them chase unhinged cravings—women ditched natural intimacy for wild setups.
Same with men—burned for each other, doing what’s off, and catching the consequences in themselves.
Since they ghosted God, He let their minds go full error mode—doing what shouldn’t even be on the menu.
They got maxed out on unrighteousness: fornication, greed, hate, envy, murder, beef, lies, and twisted vibes.
Gossipers, backstabbers, God-haters, flexers, ego monsters, evil inventors, parent-disrespecters.
No sense, no loyalty, no love, no chill, no mercy.
They know the verdict—this stuff earns death—but they still do it and hype others who do too.
So you, calling others out? You’re not off the hook—judging them while doing the same stuff? That’s wild.
God’s judgment hits different—it’s real, and it’s always on point.
You think you’ll dodge judgment while doing the exact things you condemn? Think again.
Or are you sleeping on God’s kindness, patience, and mercy—forgetting it’s meant to lead you to change?
But if you’re stacking up stubbornness and unrepentance, you’re just building wrath for Judgment Day—when God drops the receipts.
He’ll pay everyone back based on what they actually did.
Eternal life for those who keep grinding in good, chasing glory, honor, and the forever life.
But for the selfish, truth-rejecting, drama-chasing ones? Pure wrath and heat.
Trouble and stress for every soul doing evil—Jew first, then everyone else.
But glory, honor, and peace for those doing good—again, Jew first, then the rest.
God doesn’t play favorites.
Those who sin without the Law still get judged without it. Those who sin under the Law get judged by it.
It’s not just hearing the Law that counts—it’s doing it that makes you right with God.
When non-Jews do what the Law says—without even having it—they’re showing it’s written on their hearts.
Their conscience backs it up—thoughts either defending or exposing them.
All of this gets revealed on the day God judges secrets—through Jesus, as my gospel says.
You call yourself a Jew? You flex the Law and claim to rep God?
You know His will, you’ve studied the Law, and you know what’s right.
You’re convinced you’re a guide for the blind, a light in the dark.
A teacher for the clueless, a mentor for the young—since you’ve got the Law’s blueprint.
So why do you teach others but not yourself? You say “Don’t steal,” but you’re out here stealing?
You say “No adultery,” but you’re wildin’? You hate idols but rob temples?
You brag about the Law but break it—disrespecting God in the process.
Just like it’s written: “God’s name gets dragged because of y’all.”
Circumcision’s cool—if you actually follow the Law. But if you break it, your circumcision’s basically uncircumcision.
So if an uncircumcised person keeps the Law, won’t they count as circumcised?
And won’t they—without the physical sign—judge you, who has it but still breaks the Law?
Being a Jew isn’t just about the outside, and circumcision isn’t just physical.
Real Jew is inward. Real circumcision is heart-level, Spirit-led, not just rule-following. That kind of person gets praise—not from people, but from God.

Do you not know, fam, that the law only runs your life while you are still breathing.
A married woman is tied to her man by law, but if he dies, she is free from that contract.
If she links up with another while he is alive, she is wildin’. But if he dies, she is free to remarry, no cap.
Same with y’all. You died to the law through Christ’s body, so now you are cuffed to the One who rose, to bear fruit for God.
Back when we were in our flesh era, sin used the law to stir up cravings, and the result was death fruit.
But now we are released. Dead to the old rules. We serve in new Spirit mode, not the dusty letter.
So is the law sin? Nah, never. But I would not have known what sin was unless the law said, “Don’t do that.”
Sin saw the rule and said, “Bet.” It stirred up all kinds of wrong wants. No law, no sin meter.
I was vibing before the law hit. Then the command dropped, sin woke up, and I flatlined.
The command that was supposed to give life ended up handing me an L.
Sin used the rule to bait me, then bodied me.
So the law is holy. The command is holy, just, and good.
Did something good kill me? No way. Sin just used the good to show its true colors—extra evil.
The law is spiritual. But I am not. I am sold out to sin like a bad NFT.
I do not even understand myself. I do what I hate, not what I want.
If I do what I do not want, I am agreeing the law is right.
But it is not even me doing it. It is sin squatting in me.
I know nothing good lives in my flesh. I want to do right, but I cannot pull it off.
I keep failing. The good I want to do, I do not. The bad I hate, I do.
If I do what I do not want, it is not me. It is the sin virus inside.
So here is the pattern. When I want to do good, evil is right there lurking.
Deep down, I vibe with God’s law.
But I see another law in my body, beefing with my mind, dragging me back into sin’s dungeon.
I am down bad. Who is gonna rescue me from this death trap of a body.
Thank God. Jesus Christ is the one. So with my mind I serve God’s law, but my flesh still defaults to sin’s code.
There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.
For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did by sending His own Son in a body like ours, to shut sin down.
That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
For they that vibe with the flesh mind flesh things, but they that vibe with the Spirit mind Spirit things.
To be flesh-minded is death, but Spirit-minded is life and peace.
Because the flesh mind is beef with God. It does not submit to God’s law and cannot.
So those in the flesh cannot please God.
But you are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if the Spirit of God lives in you. If not, you do not belong to Christ.
And if Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
If the Spirit that raised Jesus lives in you, He will also power up your mortal bodies.
So then, fam, we are not debtors to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
If you live after the flesh, you will die. But if you kill the deeds of the body by the Spirit, you will live.
For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
You did not receive a spirit of fear again, but the Spirit of adoption, where we cry, Abba, Father.
The Spirit Himself testifies with our spirit that we are God’s children.
And if children, then heirs. Heirs of God and joint-heirs with Christ, if we suffer with Him, we will also be glorified with Him.
For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not even worth comparing to the glory that is coming.
Creation is on tiptoe, waiting for the sons of God to be revealed.
For creation was put under frustration, not by choice, but by the One who subjected it in hope.
Because creation itself will be set free from decay into the freedom of God’s children.
For we know that the whole creation groans and labors in pain until now.
And not just creation, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan too, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our bodies.
For we are saved by hope. But hope that is seen is not hope.
But if we hope for what we do not see, we wait for it with patience.
Likewise the Spirit helps our weakness. We do not know what to pray for, but the Spirit intercedes with groans too deep for words.
And He who searches hearts knows what the Spirit means, because He intercedes for the saints according to God’s will.
And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are called according to His purpose.
For whom He foreknew, He also predestined to be conformed to the image of His Son.
And whom He predestined, He also called. And whom He called, He also justified. And whom He justified, He also glorified.
What shall we say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us.
He that did not spare His own Son but gave Him up for us all, how will He not also give us everything else.
Who shall lay anything to the charge of God’s elect? It is God that justifies.
Who is he that condemns? Christ died, rose, and is at the right hand of God, interceding for us.
Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Trouble, pressure, persecution, hunger, danger, sword.
As it is written, For Your sake we are killed all day long. We are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
No. In all these things we are more than conquerors through Him that loved us.
For I am convinced that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor demons, nor the present, nor the future, nor powers.
Nor height, nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
I am speaking truth in Christ. No lies. The Holy Spirit backs me on this.
My heart stays heavy. I carry deep grief nonstop.
I could wish myself cut off from Christ if it meant saving my people.
They are Israelites. They got the adoption papers, the glory cloud, the covenants, the law drop, the worship codes, the promises.
Their ancestors are the blueprint. And from them came the Messiah in the flesh—who is above all, forever worthy.
But this does not mean God’s word flopped. Not everyone born from Israel is truly Israel.
Just because you are from Abraham’s line does not mean you are the promise. The line went through Isaac, not Ishmael.
That means it is not the natural-born who count, but the ones born from the promise.
The promise said, “I will return, and Sarah will have a son.”
And Rebekah? She had twins from one man, Isaac.
Before they were born or did anything good or bad, God made a choice—so His plan would stand, not based on effort but on the One who calls.
She was told straight up, “The older will serve the younger.”
This was God’s move—He chose Jacob, not Esau. That was His call, not ours.
So what are we saying? That God is unfair? No way.
He told Moses, “I show mercy when I choose. I give compassion when I want.”
So it is not about who runs fastest or tries hardest. It is about God showing mercy.
Scripture told Pharaoh, “I raised you up to show My power and make My name echo everywhere.”
So God shows mercy to some and lets others harden. That is His lane.
You might say, “Then how can He blame us? Who can fight His will.”
But hold up. You are human. Can the clay question the sculptor’s hands.
The potter can make a gold cup or a trash bin from the same lump. That is his right.
What if God, wanting to show wrath and power, held back on judgment for those headed for destruction.
And what if He did that to flex His glory on those He prepared for mercy.
That includes us—called not just from the Jews but also from the outsiders.
Like He said through the prophet, “I will call the not-my-people crew My people. And the unloved one, My beloved.”
In the same place they were told, “You are not Mine,” they will be called children of the living God.
Isaiah shouted about Israel, “Even if they are as many as the sand, only a few will make it through.”
God is not dragging His feet. He is wrapping things up with precision and justice.
And if God had not left us a remnant, we would have been wiped out like Sodom and torched like Gomorrah.
So what is the takeaway? The outsiders who were not chasing righteousness got it—by faith.
But Israel, chasing the law like a prize, missed the finish line.
Why? Because they tried to earn it instead of trust for it. They tripped over the stone in the road.
God dropped a stone in Zion. Some will trip. Some will trust. The ones who trust will never be put to shame.
My heart’s cry and prayer to God is this—I want my people to be saved.
I know they are passionate for God, but it is not synced with truth.
They missed God’s way of making people right and tried to build their own. So they missed the real thing.
Christ is the finish line of the law. Everyone who believes gets made right.
Moses wrote that if you want to live by the law, you have to keep every part of it.
But the righteousness that comes by faith talks different. It does not say, “Who’s gonna climb up to heaven to bring Christ down.”
Or, “Who’s gonna dive into the deep to pull Christ up from the dead.”
No. It says, “The word is right here—in your mouth and in your heart.” That’s the message we preach.
If you say with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord,” and believe in your heart God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.
Believing in your heart makes you right. Saying it out loud locks in the save.
Scripture says, “Anyone who trusts in Him will not be put to shame.”
No difference between Jew and non-Jew. Same Lord, same riches, same reach.
Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.
But how can they call if they never believed. And how can they believe if they never heard. And how can they hear if no one tells them.
And how can anyone tell them unless they are sent. As it is written, “How fire are the feet of the ones who bring good news.”
But not everyone listened to the good news. Isaiah said, “Lord, who actually believed what we told them.”
So faith comes from hearing, and hearing comes from the word of Christ.
But I ask—did they not hear The sound went out to the whole earth. The words hit every corner.
Did Israel not get the memo First Moses said, “I will make you jealous with a no-name nation.”
Then Isaiah went bold and said, “I was found by people who were not even looking for Me.”
But to Israel He said, “I kept reaching out all day to a stubborn and rebellious crew.”
So did God cancel His people? No way. I am living proof, an Israelite from Abraham’s line, tribe of Benjamin.
God did not ghost the people He picked from the jump. Remember Elijah? He was like, 'Lord, they canceled Your prophets and I am the last one.'
'Lord, they have hunted down Your prophets and wrecked Your altars. I am the only one left, and now they are coming for me too.'
But God said, 'I have seven thousand who did not bow to Baal.'
Same now. There is a remnant, chosen by grace.
And if it is by grace, it is not by grind, or else grace would not be grace.
So what then? Israel did not get what it was chasing, but the chosen ones did. The rest got spiritually benched.
As it is written, 'God gave them a deep sleep. Eyes that do not see. Ears that do not hear.' To this day.
David said, 'Let their table become a trap, a setup, a snare.'
'Let their eyes go dim and their backs stay bent.'
So did they trip just to fall forever? No way. Their stumble opened the door for the nations to get in and make Israel jealous.
If their fall brought riches to the world, imagine what their full return will bring.
I am talking to you, Gentiles. Since I am the apostle to y’all, I flex my role.
Hoping I can spark some jealousy in my people and help save some.
If their rejection meant the world got reconnected, what will their return mean but resurrection vibes?
If the first piece of dough is holy, the whole loaf is too. If the root is holy, so are the branches.
Some branches got snapped off, and you, wild olive shoots, got grafted in. So do not get cocky.
Do not flex on the broken branches. You do not hold the root. The root holds you.
You might say, 'They were cut off so I could be grafted in.'
True. But they were cut for not believing, and you stand by faith. So stay humble, not hype.
If God did not spare the natural branches, He will not spare you either.
Look at both sides of God: kindness and severity. He was severe to those who fell, but kind to you if you stay in that kindness.
And if they stop the unbelief, they can be grafted back in. God can do that.
If you were cut from a wild tree and grafted into a cultivated one, how much easier to re-graft the originals?
I do not want you clueless, fam. A part of Israel is hardened until the full squad of the nations comes in.
Then all Israel will be saved. Just like it is written: 'The Rescuer will come from Zion and cancel ungodliness.'
'This is My deal with them: I will wipe their sins.'
As far as the gospel, they are enemies for your sake. But as far as election, they are still loved for the ancestors’ sake.
God’s gifts and call are locked in. No take-backs.
You were once disobedient but now got mercy because they disobeyed.
So now they are disobedient so they can get mercy just like you did.
God locked everyone in disobedience so He could show mercy to all.
Oh, the depth of God’s wisdom and knowledge! Who can track His moves or guess His next play?
Who has known the Lord’s mind? Or been His advisor?
Who ever gave God something first that He owes them back?
Everything starts with Him, flows through Him, and ends in Him. Glory to Him forever. Amen.

Everyone should respect the ones in charge because all authority comes from God and He set it up.
If you fight the setup you are fighting God’s order and that brings judgment.
Rulers are not a threat if you are doing right but if you wild out be scared because they do not carry the badge for nothing.
They are God’s reps to keep things in check. If you do wrong they bring the heat.
So obey not just to dodge punishment but because your conscience knows what’s right.
That is why you pay taxes too. These folks are doing God’s work full-time.
Give everyone what you owe. Taxes to the tax crew. Respect to the ones who earned it. Honor where it is due.
Do not owe anyone anything—except love. Loving others means you already fulfilled the law.
The commands like do not cheat do not kill do not steal do not envy—all of them get summed up in this one line Love your neighbor like you love yourself.
Love does no harm to its neighbor. So love is the law’s final form.
And do this knowing the time. It is wake-up o’clock. Salvation is closer now than when we first believed.
The night is almost over. Daylight is coming. So drop the dark deeds and gear up with light.
Let us walk like it is daytime—not in wild parties or drunken mess not in lust or drama not in jealousy or flexing.
Instead put on the Lord Jesus Christ like a fit and do not feed the cravings of the flesh.
Welcome the one whose faith is still loading but do not argue over every little opinion.
One person eats everything. Another only eats plants. Let them both live.
The one who eats should not clown the one who does not. And the one who does not should not judge the one who does. God accepted them both.
Who are you to judge someone else’s servant? They stand or fall before their own master. And God is able to hold them up.
One person treats some days as special. Another sees every day the same. Each should be fully convinced in their own mind.
Whoever honors a day does it for the Lord. Whoever eats does it for the Lord and gives thanks. And whoever does not eat still does it for the Lord and gives thanks.
None of us lives for ourselves alone and none of us dies for ourselves alone.
If we live, we live for the Lord. If we die, we die for the Lord. So whether we live or die, we belong to Him.
Christ died and came back to life so He could be Lord of both the dead and the living.
So why are you judging your sibling? Or why are you looking down on them? We will all stand before God’s judgment seat.
As it is written: 'Every knee will bow to Me and every tongue will speak truth to God.'
So each of us will give our own account to God.
So let’s stop judging each other. Instead, decide not to trip up your sibling or throw shade in their path.
I know and am convinced in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean by itself. But if someone thinks it is unclean, then for them it is.
If your sibling is hurt by what you eat, you are not walking in love. Do not wreck someone Christ died for over food.
Do not let your good thing get dragged.
God’s kingdom is not about food and drink, but about righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
Whoever serves Christ this way is approved by God and respected by people.
So let us chase what makes for peace and builds each other up.
Do not destroy God’s work over food. All food is clean, but it is wrong to eat if it trips someone.
It is better not to eat meat, drink wine, or do anything that might trip your sibling, shake them up, or weaken their faith.
Keep your faith between you and God. Blessed is the one who does not feel guilty for what they approve.
But whoever doubts is already off if they eat, because they are not acting from faith. And whatever is not from faith is sin.
If you are strong in the faith, carry those who are still struggling. Do not just live for yourself.
Each of us should build up our neighbor. That is how we show real love.
Even Christ did not live for Himself. He took the insults meant for others and wore them.
Everything written before was for our training—so we could have hope through Scripture and endurance.
May the God who gives patience and encouragement help you live in unity, like Christ showed us.
So that with one voice, one heart, you glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
So welcome each other like Christ welcomed you. That is how God gets glory.
Christ came to serve the Jews, to confirm the promises made to the ancestors.
But He also came so the outsiders could praise God for His mercy. Like it says, “I will praise You among the nations.”
And again, “Celebrate with His people, you outsiders.”
And again, “Let all the nations praise the Lord.”
And Isaiah said, “The Root of Jesse will rise up, and the nations will put their hope in Him.”
May the God of hope fill you with joy and peace as you trust Him, so you overflow with hope by the Holy Spirit.
I am convinced you are full of goodness, packed with knowledge, and able to help each other grow.
I wrote boldly in some parts to remind you—because of the grace God gave me.
He made me a priest of the gospel to the outsiders, so they could become an offering made holy by the Spirit.
So I brag in Christ about what God has done through me.
I will not talk about anything except what Christ did through me to bring the nations to faith—by word, deed,
Signs, wonders, and Spirit power. From Jerusalem all the way to Illyricum, I have dropped the full gospel.
I made it my mission to preach where Christ was not known—so I would not build on someone else’s foundation.
Like it is written, “Those who never heard will see. Those who never knew will understand.”
That is why I have been delayed so many times from coming to you.
But now there is no more work for me in these regions, and I have been wanting to visit you for years.
I plan to stop by on my way to Spain. I hope to chill with you for a bit and get your support for the journey.
But right now I am headed to Jerusalem to serve the believers there.
The churches in Macedonia and Achaia pitched in to help the poor believers in Jerusalem.
They were glad to do it. And honestly, they owed it—since they got spiritual blessings from the Jews, it is only right to give material help back.
So after I deliver this gift and seal the deal, I will head to Spain and stop by you on the way.
I know when I come, I will bring the full blessing of Christ with me.
I urge you, fam, by our Lord Jesus and the love of the Spirit, join me in prayer. Fight with me in the Spirit.
Pray that I will be kept safe from the haters in Judea and that the gift I bring will be received well.
So I can come to you with joy, by God’s will, and get refreshed together with you.
May the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
I’m putting you on to Phoebe—she’s a real one from the Cenchreae crew, trusted and serving.
Welcome her like fam in the Lord. Help her out however she needs. She’s held it down for many, including me.
Shoutout to Priscilla and Aquila—my co-laborers in Christ Jesus.
They risked their necks for me. I owe them big time—and so do all the churches of the nations.
Greet the church that meets in their house. Salute my guy Epaenetus—the first to ride with Christ in Asia.
Greet Mary—she went all in for the squad and put in serious work for us.
Salute Andronicus and Junia—my fam and fellow inmates. They were in Christ before me and are respected by the apostles.
Greet Ampliatus—my guy, solid in the Lord.
Salute Urbanus—our teammate in Christ—and my bro Stachys, much love.
Greet Apelles—battle-tested and faithful. And say hey to the crew from Aristobulus’ house.
Salute Herodion—my kin. And the believers in Narcissus’ house who ride with the Lord.
Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa—grinders for the Lord. And Persis—she went beast mode in service.
Salute Rufus—chosen and solid. And his mom—she’s been like a mom to me too.
What’s up to Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the squad with them.
Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, Olympas, and all the saints rolling with them.
Greet each other with a holy hug. All the churches of Christ send love.
Fam, I gotta warn you—watch out for people who stir up drama and divide the squad. Stay away from them.
They are not serving Christ but their own cravings. They use smooth talk to trick hearts that are not on guard.
Everyone knows about your obedience, and I’m hyped for you. But stay sharp with good and clueless about evil.
The God of peace will soon stomp Satan under your feet. The grace of Jesus be with you.
Timothy, my teammate, says hey. So do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater—my fam.
I, Tertius—the one writing this scroll—send my love in the Lord.
Gaius says hi—he’s hosting me and the whole church. Erastus the city treasurer and our bro Quartus say hey too.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
Now to the One who can make you strong by my gospel and the message about Jesus Christ—
The mystery once hidden but now revealed, made known to all nations to spark faith and obedience—
To the only wise God be glory forever through Jesus Christ. Amen.
